headline: Revolut Funding Round Confirms $115 Billion Valuation Ahead of 2028 IPO
summary: A new funding round for digital bank Revolut confirmed its $115 billion valuation as the neobank targets an initial public offering in 2028.
why: Valuation metrics and funding announcements for major fintech unicorns signal private market appetite and future public offering pipelines.

impacts.name: Revolut
impacts.why: High private valuations confirm strong investor backing and growth expectations.
